summary.headline: International project management and business development across MENA, East Asia, and Europe
paragraphs: My experience spans international project management, business development, and risk intelligence. I have worked with Japanese organizations and overseas government agencies, investors, and private-sector clients to develop opportunities and coordinate complex international projects.

At Nikken Sekkei, where I worked from April 2007 to August 2026, my responsibilities included business development, project management, and stakeholder coordination. I worked across planning, proposals, design, procurement, and site coordination, bringing together clients, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams.

The projects in which I was involved had a combined value exceeding USD 5 billion. They included One Za’abeel in Dubai, Tadawul Tower in Riyadh, the E-JUST campus in Egypt, the Grand Mosque expansion in Mecca, and the Futur Camp Nou redevelopment proposal in Barcelona.

I also led international public relations activities, including award submissions, corporate publications, project marketing materials, and client site visits involving senior executives. I supported overseas expansion and the establishment of international offices.

Earlier, at Tokio Marine & Nichido Risk Consulting, I assessed geopolitical, security, and natural disaster risks in the Middle East and East Asia. I prepared reports for Japanese companies and government agencies to support market entry, overseas business planning, and risk management.

sections.heading: Large-Scale International Project Management

Managed project activities across design, procurement, and construction.
Led multinational teams of more than 50 specialists.
key_achievement_bullets: One Za’abeel (Dubai): Served as a core project manager, overseeing client relations and project coordination on this mixed-use development. Its THE LINK structure holds the Guinness World Records title for the longest cantilevered building.
Tadawul Tower (Riyadh): Led client communications and presentations that helped secure the Saudi Stock Exchange headquarters project, and managed client relations and project coordination.
Futur Camp Nou (Barcelona): Led client communications and presentations that helped secure the stadium redevelopment project, and managed client relations and project coordination for the proposal.
E-JUST Campus (Egypt): Supported the design of the Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology campus.
Cityscape: Developed proposals and coordinated the company’s participation in the international real estate event, helping secure a subsequent project.
Supported the establishment of multiple overseas offices.
